ceiling_note: per-prompt-majority ceiling measured at 97.9% of first-action rows
error_cost: low: a routing hint that narrows candidates, reversible by the next stage
exclusion_criteria: rows that are not the session's first action (state would be a repeated prompt)
gold_generation: majority family across sessions sharing a normalised prompt
input_fields: state = the session's opening user request (source truncates at 400 chars)
intended_use: choose the coarse tool family for an agent's first action on a user request, to narrow a tool registry before an expensive router
known_ambiguity_policy: prompts with >1 observed family keep their majority family; count and rate are reported

label_descriptions.ABSTAIN: Do nothing, or defer the decision
label_descriptions.DELEGATE: Create or update tasks, todos, or hand work to another agent
label_descriptions.EDIT: Modify an existing file or write a new one
label_descriptions.EXECUTE: Run a command, process, or program
label_descriptions.READ_SEARCH: Locate or read existing information: files, code, skills, sessions, search
label_descriptions.RESPOND: Answer the user directly without using a tool
label_descriptions.VERIFY: Check or validate something that was already produced
label_descriptions.WEB: Search or browse the web, or analyse an external page or image

source_of_gold: family of the tool the agent actually invoked first in that session (~/.z0int/episodes/next_action.jsonl, prev == [])
